Organization Structure
TechNova operates on a matrix organizational structure to promote agility and
cross-departmental collaboration. Our Executive Leadership Team, led by the CEO,
oversees the strategic direction of the company. Reporting directly to the executive
board are the Vice Presidents of our core divisions: Engineering, Human Resources,
Finance, Sales & Marketing, IT Security, Administration, and Customer Support.
Employees are encouraged to engage with leadership through open-door policies and
regular town-hall meetings, ensuring transparency across all levels of the
organization.
